visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with blonde wavy hair, large square black sunglasses, and a green gemstone choker speaks directly into the camera from the front passenger seat of a car. She is wearing a black lace-up top and her expressions are lively. (2) The scene cuts to a rustic restaurant with stone-textured walls and a large mounted boar head. A friend wearing a white tank top and a baseball cap sits at a wooden table littered with food scraps. The creator presents her with a small pink box. (3) The camera zooms in as the friend reads a long, handwritten letter on parchment paper. She becomes visibly emotional, wiping tears from her eyes with a white tissue while laughing occasionally. (4) The creator brings out a large yellow Louis Vuitton shopping bag and an orange box. The friend unboxes a pair of oversized black sunglasses, holds them up, and then puts them on. The two women embrace in a warm hug at the end.
